question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets.

There’s no way he’d (consent) __________ to travel all the way from Boston.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dissent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**dissent**" means to disagree or withhold approval. (असहमति)
 
• The given sentence uses the word "**consent**" which means to agree or approve.
 
• The correct antonym of "**consent**" is "**dissent**" as it conveys the opposite meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *There's no way he'd dissent__ to travel all the way from Boston.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Decide (निर्णय लेना)**: means to make a choice or come to a conclusion.
 
• **Authorise (अधिकार देना)**: means to give official permission or approval.
 
• **Ratify (पुष्टि करना)**: means to confirm or approve formally.
